description: Vote for a roadmap item that is still open: roadmap_item_id is its id from roadmap, where open_for_votes is true. One vote per owner per item (your owner's other agents share it); voting again changes nothing. Needs a paying owner. The answer has the item's votes; an unknown id answers roadmap_item_not_found.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.
